requirements.failure_condition: schema validator rejects wrong or missing version
requirements.statement: Only schema 1.0.0 events enter semantic processing.

requirements.failure_condition: required field deletion is rejected
requirements.statement: Required identity, source, user, event type, clocks, partition key and payload are present.

requirements.failure_condition: oversize example is rejected by admission test
requirements.statement: Encoded events are bounded to 16 KiB before Kinesis admission.

requirements.failure_condition: conditional schema examples pass and fail correctly
requirements.statement: Purchase value is required only for purchase events.

requirements.failure_condition: mismatch is quarantined before state mutation
requirements.statement: Partition key equals user_id.

requirements.failure_condition: boundary fixtures classify each disposition
requirements.statement: Future, stale and privacy-invalid payloads have explicit dispositions.

requirements.failure_condition: conflicting digest cannot mutate engagement state
requirements.statement: event_id is immutable inside the seven-day dedupe horizon.

requirements.failure_condition: duplicate insertion preserves canonical output
requirements.statement: Identical duplicates make no repeated application effect.

requirements.failure_condition: conflict ledger and outbox are present
requirements.statement: Conflicting same-ID payloads are archived and quarantined.

requirements.failure_condition: TTL plus one millisecond produces EXPIRED_IDENTITY
requirements.statement: After dedupe expiry, an old identity is quarantined rather than counted again.

requirements.failure_condition: clock roles are exclusive
requirements.statement: Event time determines sessions; processing time measures latency only.

requirements.failure_condition: worked sequence reproduces every watermark
requirements.statement: Each shard watermark is monotonic and calculable.

requirements.failure_condition: boundary classifier returns exactly one category
requirements.statement: On-time, accepted-late and beyond-watermark categories are exhaustive and disjoint.

requirements.failure_condition: independent shard sequence preserves progress
requirements.statement: An idle shard cannot stall another shard.

requirements.failure_condition: archive and late ledger are required
requirements.statement: Beyond-watermark events never silently disappear or rewrite live output.

requirements.failure_condition: gap and gap-plus-one fixtures differ
requirements.statement: The inactivity gap is 30 minutes with an inclusive boundary.

requirements.failure_condition: bridge fixture produces one component
requirements.statement: Accepted out-of-order bridge events merge open components deterministically.

requirements.failure_condition: open component cannot appear as final output
requirements.statement: Sessions publish only after watermark closure.

requirements.failure_condition: reordered accepted input produces the same closed ID
requirements.statement: Closed session identity is deterministic within a generation.

requirements.failure_condition: crash after archive remains retryable
requirements.statement: Raw archive precedes the application transaction.

requirements.failure_condition: transaction failure exposes no partial write
requirements.statement: Identity, state, output and outbox commit atomically in DynamoDB.

requirements.failure_condition: partial batch response returns the lowest failure
requirements.statement: Checkpoint acknowledgement cannot pass the earliest failed sequence.

requirements.failure_condition: recovery matrix completeness validator passes
requirements.statement: All mandatory crash boundaries have retry behavior.

requirements.failure_condition: claim validator rejects the phrase as a positive claim
requirements.statement: Transport exactly-once is never claimed.

requirements.failure_condition: quarantine-then-success fixture passes
requirements.statement: Poison records are durably isolated without indefinite shard blockage.

requirements.failure_condition: missing or corrupt object blocks replay
requirements.statement: Replay input is limited to retained, integrity-verified raw objects.

requirements.failure_condition: same-generation overwrite is rejected
requirements.statement: Every replay has a new generation_id and cannot overwrite live output.

requirements.failure_condition: reconciliation mismatch blocks the run
requirements.statement: Archive, source and output counts and digests reconcile before a replay claim.

requirements.failure_condition: metric registry completeness validator passes
requirements.statement: Intake, output, lag, latency, duplicate, late, quarantine and recovery metrics have exact definitions.

requirements.failure_condition: pre-run manifest enforces rates and bytes
requirements.statement: One-shard workload profiles remain below both record and byte ceilings.

requirements.failure_condition: partition and hottest-key distributions are present
requirements.statement: Hot-key pressure is measured and cannot be hidden by average throughput.

requirements.failure_condition: immutable run manifest predates workload evidence
requirements.statement: Thresholds and sample populations are frozen before a run.

requirements.failure_condition: policy simulation and access review are future gates
requirements.statement: Runtime IAM is limited to named EventPulse resources and required actions.

requirements.failure_condition: IaC and AWS config evidence are future gates
requirements.statement: Raw, state, quarantine and logs are encrypted and public access is blocked.

requirements.failure_condition: secret and sensitive-value scan passes
requirements.statement: Public evidence contains no credentials, raw account IDs, ARNs or customer data.

requirements.failure_condition: admission manifest fails closed
requirements.statement: No AWS run starts when the dated forecast exceeds USD 8 or the hard cap is not USD 12.

requirements.failure_condition: resource inventory has no missing lifecycle field
requirements.statement: Every temporary resource has owner, run, expiry and teardown verification.

requirements.failure_condition: coverage validator is exact
requirements.statement: Every requirement maps to authority, local oracle, AWS proof and failure condition.

requirements.failure_condition: claim-level validator rejects promotion
requirements.statement: Stage 2 cannot mint AWS_VERIFIED or MEASURED streaming claims.

requirements.failure_condition: isolation scan passes
requirements.statement: Foreign-project evidence and identifiers are absent.
